newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-CHIEFS COACH MARTY SCHOTTENHEIMER UNDERGOES KNEE SURGERY.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-CHIEFS COACH MARTY SCHOTTENHEIMER UNDERGOES KNEE SURGERY.

text.p: Kansas City Chiefs head coach Marty Schottenheimer underwent arthroscopic knee surgery on Tuesday, postponing his post-season news conference until Thursday at the earliest.
Schottenheimer was injured when he was hit on the sidelines during the third quarter of the Chiefs' 24-19 loss to the Indianapolis Colts on December 15.
Schottenheimer's future in Kansas City became uncertain following the Chiefs' total collapse in the last month of the National Football League season.
The Chiefs had been tabbed as one of the pre-season favourites to reach the Super Bowl this year. After starting the season 8-3, however, Kansas City dropped four of its last five games.
A final game defeat to the Bills in Buffalo on Sunday left the Chiefs out of the playoffs for the first first time in eight seasons, snapping the longest active streak in the NFL.
